_notes: Units: inches. Origin: outside south-west corner of the foundation (lake side, west end). x = east, y = north, z = up from top of basement slab (elevation 90'-0").

Directions are real compass directions. Ryan (2026-11-05, stated): the lake wall with the walkout faces south and the driveway is north. The plan sheets have no north arrow, but elevations A-4 (North, East) and A-5 (South, West) use the same names, so the top of each plan sheet = north. Permit site plans p09 and p11 agree.
Phone-compass headings in the photos read the lake wall as facing east. This was resolved in favor of Ryan; see facts/conflicts.md item 2.
Conversion from sheet A-1: x = A-1 'X' (from west outside face); y = 552 - A-1 'Y' (Y measured down from the north outside face).
Opening offsets: along the outside foundation line, from the west end (north and south walls) or from the south end (east and west walls). Sill is above the floor of that level.
Values marked 'scaled' are measured on 1/4"=1'-0" drawings, about +/- 2 in. 'inferred' values are worked out from other facts. null = unknown; see facts/questions-for-ryan.md.

Window unit sizes from the Menards window order (source/orders/menards-windows.pdf, 9/6/2021) are in work/findings/menards-windows.md. Only the basement windows W-L1 and W-L2 are changed here; main-level matches (S3, W-west-bath, W1, N1-N3, G-N1, G-N2) are listed there and in conflicts.md item 35.
Ryan's answers of 2026-11-06 are recorded in cabin-facts.md section 'Answers of 2026-11-06'.
